# What I would like us to agree on

## Four things

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- Publish the prompts and the steers with the code
- Disclose agent authorship the way we disclose funding
- Joint statements and hubs, when writing is cheap and anyone can be
  first out
- A named person behind every number
:::
